criterion: which semantic relation holds between the two entities stated at the end of the text ("The relation between X and Y")

categories.name: Creation/Authorship
categories.definition: One entity is the creator, author, designer, developer, or composer of the other entity (a work, product, or structure).

categories.name: Location/Containment
categories.definition: One entity is situated within, originates from, or is primarily associated with a specific geographical place or larger area.

categories.name: Part-Whole/Component
categories.definition: One entity is a constituent part, member, or subdivision of another larger entity or system.

categories.name: Classification/Type
categories.definition: One entity is identified as belonging to a particular category, class, genre, occupation, or artistic style.

categories.name: Event Participation
categories.definition: An individual, group, or country is actively involved in or associated with a specific event, competition, or campaign.

categories.name: Temporal Relation
categories.definition: Two entities are connected by their chronological order, co-occurrence in time, or a specific time period associated with an event or entity.

categories.name: Business/Organizational Relationship
categories.definition: Two entities (typically organizations or an individual and an organization) are linked by a formal business, contractual, or ownership relationship.

categories.name: Person-Role/Attribute
categories.definition: An entity specifies a particular position, characteristic, nationality, or affiliation associated with an individual.

categories.name: Recognition/Award
categories.definition: An entity is formally acknowledged, honored, or listed for an achievement, quality, or status.

categories.name: Family/Personal Relationship
categories.definition: Two individuals are connected through familial bonds or a direct personal relationship.

categories.name: Geographical Feature Connection
categories.definition: Two distinct geographical features are linked by a natural connection, such as a confluence, a tributary relationship, or a joining point.

categories.name: Linguistic/Conceptual Relation
categories.definition: Two entities are linked through their linguistic form, naming convention, or a conceptual derivation from one to the other.

categories.name: Platform/Medium
categories.definition: An entity serves as the underlying system, environment, or channel for the operation or delivery of another entity.

categories.name: Entity-Attribute
categories.definition: An entity specifies a characteristic, property, or quality of another non-person entity.
